summary_en: The Chiba Bank raised its full-year dividend forecast for fiscal 2027 (ending March 31, 2027) by 8 yen per share to 40 yen at the fiscal year-end, bringing the annual dividend to 72 yen per share from the previously forecast 64 yen, following upward revision of earnings guidance.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Full-Year Earnings Forecast for Fiscal Year Ending March 2027 and Revision of Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
The Chiba Bank revised its full-year dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027, increasing the year-end dividend per share by 8 yen to 40 yen. Combined with the interim dividend of 32 yen per share, the total annual dividend now stands at 72 yen per share, up from the previously forecast 64 yen.

The company revised its earnings guidance upward on November 9, 2026, following the interim results. Consolidated recurring profit was raised to 176.4 billion yen from the prior forecast of 154.3 billion yen, and net income attributable to parent company shareholders was increased to 122.0 billion yen from 107.0 billion yen. Earnings per share were revised to 177.56 yen from 154.71 yen.

The dividend increase reflects the company's basic policy of maintaining substantial soundness while pursuing stable dividends, active shareholder returns through share repurchases, and effective capital deployment for growth. Management stated that the upward earnings revision was driven by stronger-than-expected funding profit from lending rates and related items in the interim results.
